VariableMap.description: Names map to values or nested groups; the path joins names with dots, so names contain no `.`. Names follow the file's existing naming convention, PascalCase if it has none.

Variables.description:
Project variables, read with `ivy.var.get("myGroup.myVar")`. `#` lines directly above a key describe it.
Metadata is its own `#` line directly above the key:
- `# [password]` (encrypted; implied by names containing `password` or `secret`)
- `# [daytime]` (e.g. `08:00`)`
- `# [enum: A, B, C]`,
- `# [file: json]` or `# [file: txt]` (value read from `config/variables/<group path>/<Name>.json` or `.txt`; the entry stays, with value `""`).
